children: Bonfida’s SNS integration with Bubblemaps was updated to support the .sol Upgrade across the Bubblemaps visual analytics platform.
Bubblemaps is ready for the .sol Upgrade.
has updated its SNS integration to support the upgrade across its visual analytics platform.
Another platform ready. Kudos to the Bubblemaps team!

Bonfida is a group of experts in cryptocurrencies, analytics and engineering. Their expertise and focus are largely based on growing blockchain technology by enhancing the world of decentralized identities. Through their accumulated experience they have come to realize that a core component of identity whether on or off-chain is your name. This is how work on the Solana Name Service (SNS) began.
SNS has a simple mission of providing a decentralized and yet affordable way to map domain names (represented as .sol) to on-chain data. Where on-chain data can be anything from a Solana
address to IPFS CID, images, text, and more.

title: Bonfida to Be Integrated With Bubblemaps
